name: Settings Loading
description: YAML-backed configuration loading with built-in defaults, logging setup, and support for application-specific settings through embedding.

files.description: Loads defaults, reads app.yml/configs/app.yml, configures slog, and caches the settings instance.

Documents settings YAML shape, defaults, embedding pattern, and logging configuration behavior.
